sentences.en: Dan helped Linda find an elegant dress at the clothing shop.
sentences.zh: 丹帮琳达在服装店找到了一件优雅的礼服。

sentences.en: The double helix that encodes our genome is an elegant structure.
sentences.zh: 编码我们基因组的双螺旋结构是一种优雅的构造。

sentences.en: Your new hat is elegant, Diana, and so becoming.
sentences.zh: 你的新帽子很优雅，戴安娜，非常合适。
